name: Saionji Chris
source:
Claire's son, a handsome classmate.

A quarter-Japanese boy born to a Japanese father and a mixed-race mother.

With his signature blond hair and blue eyes, his androgynous looks make him popular with the girls in class.

An exceptionally privileged boy with excellent grades, handsome looks, and wealthy parents.

But behind that facade lies another side—a womanizer who has numerous affairs with his friends' mothers...

[From the [url=https://www.empress-game.com/yukanmadam/]official website[/url]]
